text: hey. i'm the tutorial for this phone. give me two minutes and you'll know how all of this works.
it's just a chat: i write, you answer with the buttons under the thread. when it says i'm typing, i'm typing. that's the whole thing.

then.text: then i wait. nothing breaks, nothing moves on. your call.

text: You can leave this guide and come back any time. I've unlocked Mai's five-chapter romance and her first Teahouse date.
one thing before we go on: your answers move four numbers — trust, feelings, attraction and bond. everyone you meet keeps their own four.

options.label: You're alright, tutorial
options.say: Thanks for explaining it all. You are a pretty cool guy

options.label: can you give me the shortcut...
options.say: can you give me the shortcut...

text: The number just moved. Stat changes are always accompanied by a sound. If you open the characters tab (tap my face/icon) — you can check the stats out!

then.text: You don't actually have to finish the tutorial. Feel free to explore the rest of the story whenever you're ready.

text: Some content will be gated behind stats. Want to get serious with someone? Try to find out what moves their feelings. But attraction also matters.
But without enough trust, someone might not be willing to share a secret with you.
You will learn naturally. If you need to, you can always reset the game and try different answers.
But if you really hate guessing, there is a setting to show which stat an answer will change.
Did you notice how empty the character info is? A page only shows what someone has actually told you. the rest stays locked.
so let me fill mine in. i'm 23, and my birthday's april 2nd — two separate facts, two separate lines - go check my profile again!

options.label: So the page updates as you talk?
options.say: so the page updates as you talk?

then.text: the moment someone says a thing, it lands on their page.
only what they choose to tell you, which is the interesting part.

text: interests: how things work, checklists, showing off. likes: careful reading, straight questions. dislikes: skipping the hints, walls of emoji.
look again — Even more infos now. that's the trick with everyone you meet: listen, and it fills.
quizzes ask about what people told you, and the replies that land well usually match a like or dodge a dislike. Paying attention is rewarded!

then.text: i read manuals for fun. it's on the page, like everything else.

options.label: Anything else I need to know?
options.say: anything else i need to know before i go?

then.text: the quick bar! I'll get to that next.

needs.hint: Sometimes replies are gated. (4+ trust required)

then.text: that one was locked until you'd earned it. locked replies always show a hint about what is missing, and they open when your numbers or the story are far enough.

text: before i forget — what should i call you?
okay, {name}. good to meet you properly.
now let me prove it. two questions about what I just told you.

answers.reply: exactly. hints are there to be read.
no, that one is a like.
that is just an interest of mine.

pass.text: see how that works? i told you, and it stuck. And you gained a stat. Easy isn't it?

text: So... About that Quickbar! - You got some options:Chats, Locations (basically irl chats), your image collection, a character overview and the Setting
Your Chats.. To Chat!
Locations - Basically Chats but IRL
Gallery - Collection of Pictures you have seen
Characters - It's kind of self explanatory!
And finally the settings! Just check them out. You can Save and Load Games, change the volume and other stuff. Why don't you have a look? Or just go ahead and Chat with someone. Your choice!
